description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you

Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.

Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.
Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.
AI Agent 驱动的开源可自部署视频工作台：将小说与剧本转为角色、场景、道具资产、分镜、视频和剪映草稿，支持跨镜头一致性、多供应商与费用追踪 | Self-hosted AI video workspace for stories, storyboards and short-form video production

Open source personal agent with its own computer. It chases invoices, preps your calls and cancels trials on real websites, and asks before it acts. Runs on your machine with the model you choose. By n8n.
Let AI use your iPhone or Android phone, with you in the loop: any MCP agent from macOS, Windows or Linux, or Pinky itself, right on the phone.
🤖 Local-assist BOSS Zhipin CLI for AI agents — search, welfare filtering, shortlist, JSON-envelope output; low-risk & compliant by default.
All-in-one terminal covering 30+ protocols — SSH, RDP, SFTP, databases, Kubernetes and more. With a built-in AI Agent that runs multi-turn shell commands autonomously.
A compounding agent OS for recursive agents. Also an open source alternative to Grok Bot and Meta's Muse.
A coding agent: give it a prompt and it reads, writes, runs commands, and searches code in a loop until the work is done, using native tool-calling across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models.
Your AI work partner. Mail, chats and tickets become one list in the right order; your agents do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Free, open source, runs on your computer.
